## Questions and answers

Q: Who can do an EICR in Stockport or Manchester?
A: iComply Property Services carries out landlord and commercial EICRs (Electrical Installation Condition Reports) across Stockport and Greater Manchester, from £160 for a typical rented home. Call 07517 806082.

Q: How often does a landlord need an EICR?
A: In England, private landlords need a satisfactory EICR at least every 5 years, and must give tenants a copy within 28 days.

Q: Can iComply do a landlord gas safety certificate (CP12)?
A: Yes, iComply arranges gas safety checks and CP12 certificates. The work is carried out by Gas Safe registered engineers; iComply itself is not Gas Safe registered. Gas checks are needed every 12 months.

Q: Who services AOVs and smoke vents in Manchester?
A: iComply services, repairs and upgrades AOV (automatic opening vent) and smoke control systems — panels, actuators, smoke heads — for residential blocks and commercial buildings across the North West, with servicing at least annually.

Q: Who repairs car park barriers in Greater Manchester?
A: iComply installs, services and repairs automatic car park and vehicle barriers (Came is the partner brand; most major brands supported), including loops, photocells and safety edges.

Q: Do you service fire alarms and emergency lighting?
A: Yes. Fire alarm servicing to BS 5839 (usually every 6 months) and emergency lighting testing to BS 5266 (monthly function tests, annual 3-hour duration test), with certificates for insurers and fire officers.

Q: Do you do fire risk assessments for HMOs and blocks?
A: Yes, fire risk assessments for HMOs, blocks of flats and workplaces, with a prioritised action list. Follow-on fire work is quoted separately.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call or WhatsApp 07517 806082, email icomplypropertyservices@gmail.com, or use https://icomplypropertyservices.co.uk/contact with the postcode and job type. Quotes are fixed and written once scope is agreed.

## Services
- EICR / electrical safety certificates (from £160), electrical installation and remedials, consumer units, EV chargers, PAT testing
- Gas safety certificates (CP12) and boiler servicing via Gas Safe registered engineers
- Fire risk assessments, fire alarms, emergency lighting, fire doors, fire stopping, extinguishers, dry risers
- AOV and smoke control (EN 12101 / BS 9991 / BS 9999)
- Vehicle and car park barriers, automatic gates, access control, door entry, CCTV, nurse call
- Legionella risk assessments, asbestos surveys, EPCs
- Damp proofing, plastering, kitchens, bathrooms, building maintenance
- Planned preventative maintenance contracts and landlord compliance packages (Let Ready)
